profile.description: Active PRCA rodeo with 12,000+ spectators, a free family kickoff, nightly kids zone, vendors and entertainment.

notes.subject: Old response was only out-of-office; event remains a possible fit
notes.body: The Dec. 2023 unread message was only an out-of-office auto-reply and should not be treated as a decline. Current City of Idaho Falls information confirms War Bonnet Round Up remains a large family-friendly PRCA rodeo with a free kickoff, nightly kids zone, vendors and 12,000+ spectators. The 2026 vendor deadline has passed. Current vendor contact is Hollie Pettingill, 208-612-8479, hpettingill@idahofalls.gov.

followUps.label: Check 2027 War Bonnet Round Up vendor/attraction plan
followUps.reason: The event is large and family-friendly and the only historical reply was an auto-response. Contact the current vendor/event team early for 2027 before the application deadline.
